subject: Commitment backstop and MAP replan — Orbit Logistics
messages:
From: Sara Levin <sara@orbitlogistics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@orbitlogistics.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commitment timing and pilot MAP

Hi Mina,

Quick update from our side — procurement has flagged an additional compliance review that will add roughly 10 business days to our signature path. That pushes the commercial close past the pilot start we originally planned.

We still want to get the evaluation moving (the technical team is ready), but we need a pragmatic MAP that protects Redwood from open-seat risk while letting us run the key evals. Can you propose: 1) a short-term access plan so our engineers can finish the performance tests, 2) an updated milestone schedule with a clear backstop (what happens if procurement slips again), and 3) any temporary credits or sandbox terms you can offer to keep momentum?

I attached our procurement_schedule.pdf for context.

Thanks,
Sara
Director, IT Procurement
Orbit Logistics

Attachment: procurement_schedule.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Levin <sara@orbitlogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Commitment timing and pilot MAP

Sara — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the schedule. We can absolutely keep the evaluation moving while procurement completes the compliance review. High-level proposal below; I'll attach a draft MAP (proposed_map_v2.xlsx) with milestone dates and acceptance criteria.

Proposed short-term actions (immediate):
- Sandbox access: provide restricted sandbox (shared GPU pool, token-limited) for 2 weeks so your SREs can complete perf tests.
- Support: dedicated office hours with our infra engineer (1x/day) during the test window.
- Temporary credits: 10k token credit applied to the pilot account to cover initial runs.

Replanned milestones (example):
- Technical evaluation complete: target 2027-12-08
- Procurement signature: updated target 2027-12-20 (per your schedule)
- Production readiness / handoff: 2028-01-05

Backstop & escalation (if procurement slips >10 business days):
- Automatic escalation to senior commercial (Marissa) with revised MAP within 3 business days.
- Option for time-limited extension of the sandbox + additional credits (structured as a one-time concession) to preserve evaluation continuity.

I've looped in Marissa and Karthik to confirm commercial terms and any credit approvals. Rishi — can your team prepare a one-page test playbook that we can use to keep acceptance criteria objective?

I attached the draft MAP for review. I'll follow up with a formal MAP and a HubSpot update.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_map_v2.xlsx (Excel, 35KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Levin <sara@orbitlogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Commitment timing and pilot MAP

All — quick commercial note. We can approve the 10k token credit Mina proposed as a one-time courtesy tied to completion of the acceptance test window. If procurement ultimately signs on the updated 2027-12-20 target, the credit is not converted to a recurring concession.

If procurement slips beyond the 10 business-day window, we have two options:
1) Extend the sandbox + an incremental 5k token credit (requires VP approval) — this keeps the evaluation live but we escalate for written approval.
2) Convert to an explicit MAP amendment that includes a limited start-of-billing waiver for up to 30 days post-signature (commercial legal needs to draft).

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Sara / team — operationally we can stand up the restricted sandbox by EOD tomorrow. Two asks: 1) we need a prioritized test plan (Rishi, can you confirm), and 2) please share the list of IP ranges so our networking team can pre-authorize traffic.

If you want to preserve the public close date, we can shift non-essential milestones (training cutover, analytics integration) to after signature and keep the pilot acceptance date as planned. I'll add a short MAP change log to the shared Drive folder so everyone has a single source of truth.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Eng
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (link to Drive) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orbit-map

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orbitlogistics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sara Levin <sara@orbitlogistics.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@orbitlogistics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Commitment timing and pilot MAP

Mina / Sara — thanks for the pragmatic proposal. We can accept the sandbox and token credit approach. A couple of asks from procurement: 1) we need a short SLA summary that covers the sandbox performance baseline and support response times, and 2) we must have the KYC/compliance packet returned before the DocuSign route (legal will not sign otherwise).

I'm starting the internal approval tomorrow and will route the DocuSign once KYC is in place. Please share the SLA summary and the DocuSign link for the MAP amendment when ready.

—Raj
Head of Digital Transformations
Orbit Logistics

Attachment: orbit_docsign_agreement.pdf (PDF stub, 8KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@orbitlogistics.com>, Sara Levin <sara@orbitlogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Commitment backstop and MAP replan — Orbit Logistics

Team — attaching the final MAP v2 and an SLA one-pager. Summary of decisions and next steps: 

Decisions agreed:
- Sandbox: restricted environment delivered by 2027-12-01 EOD.
- Credits: 10k tokens applied immediately; additional 5k token extension requires VP sign-off if procurement slips beyond the 10-business-day window.
- Milestones: Technical evaluation completion moved to 2027-12-08; target signature 2027-12-20; production readiness 2028-01-05.
- Backstop: If procurement slips >10 business days we trigger a commercial escalation and present either the 5k-credit option or a start-of-billing waiver for up to 30 days post-signature.

Action items:
- Rishi: finalize one-page test playbook and IP list by 2027-12-02.
- Karthik: confirm sandbox build and pre-authorize IP ranges (completed).
- Marissa: hold the 10k credit in deal notes; prepare escalation package if triggered.
- Sara/Raj: return KYC packet by 2027-12-06 to keep DocuSign on track.

Links and artifacts:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.company/deal/ORBIT-2027-47
- MAP draft (final): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orbit-map
- DocuSign (will be sent once KYC clears)

I'll update the HubSpot timeline and set a 2027-12-03 check-in to confirm procurement progress. If procurement sends an earlier ask for expanded credits, please escalate to Marissa directly.

Thanks everyone — good momentum despite the slip.

—Mina
Senior Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_map_v2.xlsx (final), SLA_onepager.pdf (summary)
